Variants.Content: The Salt Coast is a coastal territory in southern Dorne near the Summer Sea. Salt pans, tide pools, fishing boats and sun-bleached stone beaches constitute daily life here; salt is not only a condiment, but also an important ingredient for preserving meat, fish and supplies for long journeys. Dorne's hot and dry climate makes water more worthy of guarding than gold, but seawater can be turned into salable salt through labor. Coastal residents have contacts with the Greenblood River, Sunspear and the Stepstone Islands, and understand that sea routes bring business opportunities and plunder. The stabilizing effects of the salt coast were production, storage, and coastal exchange that did not depend on any brief political occupation.

Those who repaired the salt coast were familiar with shipbuilding wood, canvas, salt, fish catches, and stones to withstand the sea breeze. Those who comforted the families of the deceased were familiar with the shared memories of the Seven Gods, the legacy of the Rhoynar, and the different bloodlines under the prince's rule. A stronghold was therefore not just a lord's hall, but also a place where weddings and funerals, vows, labor and local memories recurred.

Entry Salt Shore They care about wells and springs, irrigation canals, orchards, drought-tolerant livestock, and routes to avoid the scorching sun. They also look at whether seeds are left after collecting grain and whether the city gates are open in times of disaster. When people from afar see coats of arms, what they see is whether there will be food to eat tomorrow.
